luiskr.com / experiments/star-field/engine/registry / loadRegistryShard

function loadRegistryShard(kind, shardIx): Promise<SFRegistryRecord[] | null>;

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/registry.ts:130

Fetches (or returns the cached promise for) one 1,000-record shard — shards are the lazy-load unit so browsing the catalogue never pulls the full 14 MB index up front.

Parameters

kind

string

Record kind (star/exoplanet/dso).

shardIx

number

Zero-based shard index.

Returns

Promise<SFRegistryRecord[] | null>

The parsed record array, or null on failure.
